figurative_meaning_en: Having poor appetite or weak digestion
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে আঁতমরা বলে খাবারে খুব কম খায়।
বয়স হওয়ায় তার আঁতমরা হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He eats very little because he has a weak stomach.
With age, his digestion has become weak.
note: Refers to traditional Bengali views on bodily health and eating habits
